decisions.reason: As the integrated combined robot sits at the core of the firm's automation strategy and project-based carrying costs are modest, management would keep this option open unless clearer evidence of weak demand emerges.
The stand-alone de-shuttering robot still preserves value as a modular entry solution for customers not buying the full combined system, though overlap with Product A raises its exit risk somewhat.

The automatic shuttering robot remains a credible modular complement to the firm's established lines, so management would keep it while watching whether demand holds up relative to the combined robot.
Because this 2024 product line is still very new and extends the firm's established plant-equipment offering with several models, the uncertainty is not yet resolved enough to justify withdrawal.

Production analysis software strengthens the firm's integrated equipment-and-service proposition and likely has strategic option value for digital lifecycle support, so management would continue it while market acceptance becomes clearer.
